name: RC-B10-0533/2026 – After § 8 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text: 8a. Calls for the formal termination of Türkiye’s EU accession negotiations and the development, in their place, of a pragmatic and mutually beneficial partnership that reflects current geopolitical and economic realities and is based on clearly defined common interests;
